NeoMe danse dans le labyrinthe : mange t: NeoMe dances in the maze: eat all the notes to reach the next level. Four little ghosts chase her, each in its own way: Plum tracks her, Mint cuts her off, Honey comes from behind and Currant wanders. The discs make the ghosts flee for a few seconds: that's the time to catch them. Studio items appear under the crypt, and an extra life awaits you at 10,000 points. Every 3 levels, a new maze: Disco, Crystal, Garden, Ember, Neon, Ocean then Galaxy.
Cinq minutes pour le plus gros score, da: Five minutes for the biggest score, in a random maze. Grey ghosts sleep in the corridors: when NeoMe passes by, they wake up and line up behind one of the four ghosts. Eat a disc and gobble the whole line: 100, 200, 300 points… more and more. The notes come back as soon as they are all eaten, and everything gets a bit faster.

Jeu de labyrinthe en pixel art : NeoMe m: Pixel art maze game: NeoMe eats every music note while four little ghosts chase her, each in its own way (Prune hunts her, Menthe cuts her off, Miel catches her from behind, Groseille prowls). Records make them flee: that's the time to catch them. Bonus items from the Studio, faster and faster levels, an extra life at 10,000 points. NeoMe has her real sprites from NeoBestiary Studio. Four mazes (Disco, Crystal, Garden, Embers) that change every 3 levels; full screen and a game that fits the screen. A 5-minute Championship mode with sleeping ghosts that line up, and seven mazes.
